text:
Sam: Quick heads up — we need to bump lockfiles and sync submodules before the v1.4.0 cutoff (today 18:00 UTC). I ran the release CI and builds are flaking on checksum/vendor mismatches. Who can own the lockfile/submodule sync and PRs?

Maria: I can take the main repo lockfile + webui yarn.lock. Will do a dry run locally first. Which repos are in-scope for this cutoff?

Sam: Scope: 
- repo:root (go service + go.mod, vendor)
- infra (submodules: third_party/onnxruntime, third_party/tensorrt)
- webui (yarn.lock)
- sdk (python/requirements.txt and wheel vendor)
Please avoid feature merges after cutoff — only dependency fixes.

Chen: Infra note — infra/third_party/onnxruntime submodule is pinned to a commit that's missing on the mirror (CI clone fails). I can try `git submodule sync && git submodule update --init --recursive` and push updated submodule pointer. Might need to mirror the commit if it's gone.

Alex: For Go root: run
```
git checkout release/v1.4
git pull origin release/v1.4
go mod tidy
go mod vendor
git add vendor go.sum
git commit -m "deps: vendor/lockfile bump for release"
git push origin HEAD:deps/lockfile-bump
```
I'll open a PR and mark it WIP until infra submodule pointer is fixed.

Maria: For webui I'll run:
```
yarn install --frozen-lockfile || yarn install
# if yarn changes yarn.lock, commit the change
git commit -am "deps: yarn.lock bump for release"
```
I will target branch `release/v1.4` and set PR title `deps(webui): yarn.lock bump` and tag @Sam @Kate

Kate: Heads-up about CI: we have a strict lockfile check job on the release pipeline. Do NOT skip it. If CI fails because of a transient registry outage, we should re-run rather than flip flags. If we need to temporarily skip for emergency, ping me.

release-bot: :alarm_clock: Reminder: release cutoff for v1.4.0 is in 2 hours (2024-03-16T18:00:00Z). After cutoff only release owners may merge.

Sam: Thanks. Two coordination asks: (1) Prefix all dependency PRs with `deps/` and target `release/v1.4`, (2) assign PRs to Maria as release lead for final approval. Also please add a short PR description listing commands you ran and CI green links.

Chen: I'll claim infra submodule pointer and post the exact commands and failure logs in the PR. If I can't find the missing commit, I'll vendor the third_party sources into infra/third_party and adjust submodule to point to new commit — will discuss in PR.

Alex: I'll wait for infra pointer before un-wip my PR. If infra needs a fast patch, I can include a fallback that uses older ONNX runtime with a note.

Maria: I'll open webui PR in ~25m. Will run both `yarn install --frozen-lockfile` and then `yarn install` if needed and include the diff.

Sam: Great — last thing: please post PR links here when opened. If anyone expects >30m work, call it out so we can reassign before cutoff. Thanks! :thumbsup:

Kate: Copy — monitoring CI.

Maria: PR opened: https://github.com/redwood-inference/webui/pull/482 — title `deps(webui): yarn.lock bump for release` — assigning @Maria @Sam

Chen: Starting infra work now, will update thread with logs.

Sam: Appreciate it. I'll hold releases.team on standby and will not cut the tag until all `deps/` PRs are merged.

(End of thread)
